description_en: Queries the time series data of hot data stored for a device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询设备热数据的时序数据
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-devices-hot-storage-data --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --page-size 10 --start-time 1579249499000 --identifier temperature --asc 0 --end-time 1579249499000 --user-topic user/a000/b000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDevicesHotStorageData

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of data records that can be returned for a single field identifier. Maximum value: 100.

The number of data records returned for any field does not exceed this value
parameters.help_zh:
单个字段标识符可返回的数据记录数量，最大值为100。

任意一个字段返回的数据记录数量均不超过该值
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备所属的产品ProductKey。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的名称。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns this token. Include this token in the next request to retrieve the next page
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识。如果存在下一页，服务会返回此token，下次请求带上即可
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data records to query. The value must be less than the end time specified by EndTime. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的数据记录的开始时间，必须小于结束时间EndTime。取值为毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The field identifier in the stored hot data. This is the field identifier in the Items request parameter used when calling the WriteDevicesHotStorageData operation to write hot data
parameters.help_zh: 已存储热数据中的字段标识符。即调用WriteDevicesHotStorageData接口写入热数据中请求参数Items中的字段标识符
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of data records in the response. Valid values:

0: descending order.
1: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中数据记录的排序方式，取值：

0：倒序。
1：正序
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The device ID.
<notice> IotId is a globally unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID。
<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time of the data records to query. The value must be greater than the start time specified by StartTime. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的数据记录的结束时间，必须大于起始时间StartTime。取值为毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The custom topic to which the data you want to query belongs. Enter all categories after the `user` category of the custom topic.

For more information about custom topics, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85539.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询数据所属自定义Topic。从`user`类目开始，输入自定义Topic的后续所有类目。

自定义Topic详细说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85539.html
parameters.name: user_topic

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功后，返回的数据

NextValid.description_en:
Indicates whether a next page of property records exists.

true: A next page exists.
false: No next page exists.

If NextValid is true, you can use the value of NextPageToken as the NextPageToken in the next request to retrieve the remaining data
NextValid.description_zh:
是否有下一页属性记录。

true：有。
false：没有。

返回NextValid为true时，可以将NextPageToken的值作为下次查询的NextPageToken，继续查询本次查询不显示的数据

nextPageToken.description_en: The token for the next page

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
